Lumos Insight is the research and consulting practice of Luke Montuori. The
work sits at the intersection of measurement, knowledge systems, and artificial
intelligence — how we make the invisible visible, the tacit explicit, and the
immeasurable measurable.

## Research

Lumos Insight began with psychometric survey development — inferring meaning
from human behaviour through validated measurement. That foundation now informs
work on semantic quantification, cognitive extension, and the role of
evaluation in AI systems. The [Research](research.qmd) page sets out the three
lines of work and the publications behind them; the [Posts](posts.qmd) are
snapshots of thinking in progress.

## Consulting

Alongside the research, I work as a freelance psychometrician. Clients have
included test publishers, leadership and talent consultancies, and HR firms,
usually on workplace and educational assessments: leadership and capability
questionnaires, personality and ability measures, situational judgement tests
and screening batteries.

The work tends to sit between design and evidence:

- writing and reviewing items against construct definitions
- piloting new instruments and diagnosing problems before standardisation
- factor structure and validity: EFA/CFA, network psychometrics, links to performance and 360 data
- semantic pre-validation: using language-model embeddings to screen item pools before anyone responds
- scoring models, weighting and technical documentation

If you're building or revising an assessment, get in touch.
